verdict.rationale: AMD explicitly describes some accompanying components (the GAIA agent framework and the Lemonade SDK) as open-source, but the core Ryzen AI Software stack (Quark quantization toolkit, Vitis AI Execution Provider, driver/runtime) is not documented as open-licensed, and the chip's own hardware design is obviously proprietary. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license for the main Ryzen AI Software/runtime stack, license file/repo links, and any independent confirmation of source availability beyond the GAIA README.
